speaker: Doctor
text: Can you point to the exact location of your pain, and has it radiated to your back or shoulder? Also, have you experienced any nausea, vomiting, or changes in your bowel movements?

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia. Given your recent heart attack and the classic "pain out of proportion" with bloody stools, this is likely due to a clot blocking blood flow to your intestines. We need to confirm this immediately with a CT angiogram of your abdomen. REQUEST TEST: CT Angiography Abdomen/Pelvis.
